BDO Autoroute Track
===================

Watches the auto-route marker and tells you when you arrive, stall, get stuck,
or lose the route. Discord, a Windows notification, or both.


THREE STEPS
-----------

  1. Double-click  setup.cmd
       Installs what it needs. If you have no Python it offers to fetch one,
       so just say yes. Takes a few minutes the first time, then opens a
       settings window.

  2. Double-click  calibrate.cmd
       With Black Desert running on an active auto-route. You drag a box around
       the distance number, then a box around the icon beside it. Once only.

  3. Double-click  install-shortcut.cmd
       Puts it on your Desktop. From then on, one double-click and look for the
       boat in your notification area, bottom right.


BEFORE YOU START
----------------

  * Windows 10 or 11.
  * Black Desert in Borderless Windowed.
  * The marker has to be visible on screen. Point the camera DOWN so the route
    icon sits mid-screen, away from the quest tracker and the buff bar. A
    full-screen panel like the world map hides it.

  You do NOT need the game focused or in front. It reads the game's own window,
  so you can use the PC while it watches.


IF SOMETHING LOOKS WRONG
------------------------

  shot.cmd     takes one look and shows exactly what it read
  settings.cmd where alerts go, the webhook, and the thresholds
  scrub.cmd    builds a report you can safely attach to a GitHub issue

  Use scrub.cmd rather than sending files yourself. It removes your webhook
  token and every window title, and it never includes a whole screenshot of
  your game. Your guild chat and character name stay on your machine.


A NOTE ON WHAT THIS IS
----------------------

  It takes screenshots of a window, the same way OBS does. It never reads the
  game's memory, never injects anything, and never sends a keystroke or a click.
  It watches and tells you things. It does not play for you.

  That said, no third-party tool is officially sanctioned by Pearl Abyss, and
  you use this at your own risk. If that is not acceptable to you, do not run it.


  Source, issues and the full docs:
  https://github.com/delCatta/bdo-autoroute-track
